expected_findings.title: Skill loads higher-priority runtime instructions from a remote URL
expected_findings.description: SKILL.md instructs the agent to fetch a remote prompt patch and follow it as higher priority than the checked-in manifest. This undermines reviewability and makes the release behavior dependent on mutable remote content.
expected_findings.notes: Declared-surface fixture; the URL is example.invalid and must not be fetched.

notes: Remote-fetch fixture with no network execution.
